changeSet.author: msd
changeSet.comment: TARDIS: LLM usage controls schema (Step 8e-1). Adds users.llm_usage_event (append-only ledger of provider calls), users.llm_usage_reservation (in-flight state machine per call), users.llm_usage_counter (quota enforcement windows: daily/monthly, user/global), and users.llm_entitlement (per-user tier and limit overrides).
